info.description:
Environment for running the Blog CMS collection against a local development server.

How to use:
1. Import this file into Postman (Environments tab → Import).
2. Select 'Blog CMS — Local' as the active environment.
3. Run Auth/Login or Auth/Register — tokens are saved here automatically.
4. All protected requests read {{accessToken}} from this environment.
